comparison.objective: Seat two wireless earbuds in a charging case, latch the lid, and tray the case.
comparison.physical_skill: Small-part placement, snap seating, lid closure, and case transport.
comparison.success_condition: Title implies both earbuds seated, lid latched, and case placed in a tray; body and quantitative rubric are absent.
comparison.reason: Snap-fit assembly and closure are meaningfully different from hammer-driven sacrificial-tang fracture and recovery.
